responsibilities: Провайдер LLM для Lorne: профили, сохранение конфигурации, OpenRouter.

public_api.name: get_ollama_model_quirks
public_api.description:
Best-effort per-family defaults for an Ollama tag (e.g. ``qwen2.5:7b``).

Falls back to a generic "assume native tools, 32k ctx" entry for unknown
families. This does not replace explicit user overrides in
``ollama_model_settings`` — it onl…

public_api.name: fetch_ollama_model_show
public_api.description:
Query Ollama ``/api/show`` for a model's real metadata (cached).

Used to clip a too-large ``num_ctx`` down to what the model actually
supports, instead of trusting a single hardcoded default for every tag.

public_api.name: get_ollama_model_max_ctx
public_api.description:
Best-effort real context-length ceiling for a model, via ``/api/show``.

Returns ``None`` when unknown (offline server, unsupported field, etc.)
so callers can fall back to the family-quirk default instead.

public_api.name: get_model_capabilities
public_api.description:
Return capability flags for a given model based on its provider prefix.

with the per-tag quirks registry, since native tool-calling support is

public_api.name: supports_parallel_tool_calls_param
public_api.description: Check if the model's provider supports the parallel_tool_calls binding parameter.

public_api.name: is_reasoning_model
public_api.description: Check if the model is a reasoning/thinking model that emits <think> blocks.

public_api.name: get_available_models
public_api.description: Curated models + user-added OpenRouter/Ollama models from UI prefs.

public_api.name: check_lmstudio_server
public_api.description: Quick reachability check for an LM Studio server (``GET /v1/models``).

public_api.name: set_model
public_api.description: Set model, persist, and rebuild profiles. Returns the model_id.

public_api.name: fetch_openrouter_credits
public_api.description:
Fetch account credits/usage from OpenRouter API.
Returns dict with 'usage', 'limit', 'is_free_tier', 'rate_limit' or None on error.

public_api.name: fetch_openrouter_model_metadata
public_api.description: Fetch one model card from OpenRouter /models by id.
